answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Work waits on the garden until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the mesa of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the bridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
